clauses.reason: 莫 (no member of the domain holds) is what Neutral defines (Neutral is the 无X used for 无亲/无方); the other quantifier words go to other declarations.
故 introduces the consequent coming out of (derived from) the antecedent, the relation Derives defines; clauses 3-5 then use it.
States the two ethical premises and their roles: the first fixes scope without ordering (Unrestricted), the second alone fixes better (Comparison).
One thing occupying both roles is what Web.roles builds (a web on F ⊕ C).
Completes the definition of 待网: its records are indexed by step, part of what Web defines.
Asserts persistence under per-step decidedness; persists states it, and persists_of_em is the case where excluded middle supplies the decidedness.
States family_iff and spells out its right side, containing every run of the process the family shows, which is SpliceClosed's content; ShownBy is only referred to.
States same_histories_iff, with 有行所经之移 spelling out live (the transitions some run passes).
The claim that history does not show transitions no run passes is witnessed by the dead-end law (a step with no run at all).
Describes the construction (move put into the state, withMove) and the round trip leaving state and move unchanged.
Defines 宇 (World) with its parts: exchange moves between steps (World.move) and a run of the process admitting every transition (everyStep).
诸宇 is the type of all modelled worlds, the type World.
Only introduces 观 as a collective name; it gives none of the content of Process, Frame or World.
Every sequence is a course (freeRun_course); alike steps iff the values agree from them on (alike_moments_iff), the latter spelled out as SameAhead.
States separation_faithful_iff and spells out its two defs: the separate description (Separated) and free pairing (Rectangular).
The other direction of the iff (not rectangular means separation adds pairs), with the equality relation as the witness of an extra pair.

Contextual propositions as relata of a world along a run (Contextual.world), active exactly where within and shown with that value (world_active); indexed_fits concerns a frame's realization, not the world.
States ends_within and spells out its hypothesis Decays (the reserve drops whenever positive at an unsupported step).
Activity propagates along chains of positive-need dependence on embodied things: active_along, with the chain relation bearing spelled out.
Only defines the word 消息 as the balance equation; the assertion that it holds is clause 2 (held_over_stretch).
Balance for listed holdings without finiteness: Listed.over_stretch, with the listing hypothesis (each listed once per step) spelled out as Listed.
Reads clause 2's law on activity; that law's main hypothesis is recurrent covering, with listing as its parenthetical case, so both versions apply.
States renewers_unbounded and spells out its hypothesis Capacity (each gives at most a fixed amount per step).
Joint take exceeding giving over n steps ends what needs at least m: joint_excess_ends; outrun_ends is the case where a group of takers alone outruns the giving.
States returns_iff; Law.Returns is only used (复 is defined in clause 1), not defined here.
Defines 剥 for a thing using a condition (UnderminingOn, and UnderminingAt for the thing at the step), with the unbroken dependence whose need was met (MetAbove) spelled out.
Under a balanced flow (凡衡) the identity is Balances.withheld; withheld_at assumes only local balance, a more general law the clause does not state.
Defines inclusion along a reading, the first conjunct of WidensAlong (clause 3 only names the conjunction).
Defines exceeding along a reading, the second conjunct of WidensAlong.
States grow_widensAlong_iff_new; clause 6 continues the sentence, which with this clause gives grow_widens_unregistered (its first conjunct is asserted here).
Stated for histories over a listed family with decided admission, which is the web theorem; the abstract list version is a more general lemma not stated.
Any class of orders containing the positive weightings, each increasing: widens_iff_every_of_class for histories; the all-increasing abstract version is not stated.
States extensional_iff_lumped and spells out Extensional (propositions that imply each other are one).
States unique_iff and spells out Connected (every exchange touches a thing; any two are equal or share one).
Defines coupling via dependence and asserts the depended condition enters only through its need's threshold, which alike_of_threshold proves.
The given level coupling is part of CoupledInto, and that it couples the level in is observed_level_couples.
Defines selection through coupling (SelectsThrough) and spells out its condition, no difference up to a step (AlikeThroughUpTo).
States through_sensitive (first conjunct of least_coupling) under the hypothesis ReadsFinitely, which the clause spells out.
Introduces exclusion within admitted histories (ExcludesWithin) by its characterization, excludesWithin_iff_conjunction.
States Scope.secures and spells out its hypothesis Sound (admissible questions, common answers, abandon only on empty belief).
States split and spells out Remainder (if it adheres then it is inside).
States refutable_passes_iff_markov and spells out ByPrefixes (marks fixed by the prefix) and Passes (marked false at every step).
About this law's orbit held in the family: held_rest_unrefuted; rest_unrefuted for any lasso is a more general lemma not stated here.
Defines 习 as selecting through what is seen (Through) and states that selection by a loss computed from the data is through (loss_through).
The name of a sense is what the code assigns it, which is ReadsAs (the name x reads as sense n under code c).
Defines 码 (a code, a map from senses to names), a type, not any listed declaration.
载法 is carries_law_iff's left side; for the universal name it follows from goAlike_const through carries_law_iff.
Agreement right after imposing is impose_agrees; agreement through later listening (run_from_imposition) needs clause 5.
Exactly what is lost, and the source losing nothing, for the imposed code; the run version (run_from_imposition) is clause 5's extension.
The complement family carries every response fixed by d's level (Complement.carry), with the supply response as the case that clause 3 contrasts (supply_carried_by_complement).
Defines the response domain (WithinResponse) as closure under exchange in either flow on a condition coupled into a thing, spelling out CoupledFromEither.
Any change of sameness passes through an outside exchanger whose coupling differs; closing (apart then equal, clause 3's 复合) is such a change, so closes_through_coupling_apart is a case.
Next state depends only on the rule, so states with the same rule agree from the next step: reabsorbed for any rule reading, perturbation_reabsorbed for state paired with rule.
States unread_course and spells out its hypothesis Unread (neither the next share nor the read rule reads the outside part).
States lock_outlives_loss and spells out its hypothesis Accrues (outside part grows by at least one each step).
Each named route has its formal content: coupling by level seeing a raise (observed_raise_couples), admitted histories (ExcludesWithin), pooled coupling (SelectsThroughAll).
Defines pooled selection (SelectsThroughAll) and spells out no difference through every member's coupling up to a step (AlikeThroughAll).
States the iff most_difference_arrives; taking a as what is carried gives gap_le_carried, its bounding half.
Loop formation: a step's coupling closing a chain makes a loop (onLoop_of_closing), and a loop first exists only so (forms_by_closing).
Every loop by T+1 was there at T or formed by a coupling at T: the forward direction of onLoop_succ_iff, which for a new loop is forms_by_closing.
Links multiplying by whole numbers spell out scaling; product zero gives zero after the first round (whole_factors, first conjunct).
Defines 还, the return that RespondsByReturn formalizes (equivalent under balance to the gap recurrence, clause 2).
States break_carried_nowhere and spells out its hypothesis ReadsBelow (the law reads c only below its threshold).
States inherits_of_drawn and spells out both hypotheses: offspring gathers only what parents used (DependsOnDrawn), using implies depending (DrawingDepends).
Defines 传择 by its content: only supported things have offspring (DescendsAt.supported), and needs transmitted within a bound are selected within it (transmitted_supported).
States price and spells out offspring (total over offspring) and selected (parents' amounts weighted by offspring count).
States support_not_lower and spells out Descended (each generation formed from the offspring of the last).
Spells out the weighted sum over sampled k-generation histories (sampled) and states its value (sampled_count).
States selected_alike_iff; its 'same value, selected alike' half for every equivariant selection is selects_through_lumping.
For any reading of amounts positions sum to zero (positions_balance); drawn amounts are such a reading (drawn_positions, first conjunct).
Rises equal falls for any change of amounts (change_balances), with drawn amounts as a case (drawn_positions).
A rise needs another's fall (rise_needs_fall), with drawn amounts as a case (drawn_positions).
Asserts that the withheld-levels history exists; WithheldLevels is only referred to (defined in 六·五) and no listed declaration states existence.
Defines 活皆有顾 (every living proposition significant from every position), which both defs formalize at the valuation and frame levels.
Given a position and a living event, significance iff seed, no 亲, no 方: the same law in the web model and along a run's conditions.
Continues clause 1's iff by saying it needs neither connection nor no-transmission, the exact hypotheses of significant_iff_held.
The step, relation and whole-run readings as instances of clause 1, including the stepwise self-valuation.
A universal claim (whatever is widened loses a significant continuation); the inflow example is one instance whose specifics the clause does not state.
States subTrue_significantWithin_iff and spells out SubTrue (true in some admissible boundary).
True in every admissible boundary (SuperTrue) iff everything is significant: presupposition_scopes' second conjunct.
That widening-as-better does not fix the order of mixed pairs is witnessed by two appraisals that both respect Comparison yet select differently.
States universal_reason_of_unrestricted with A read for living propositions (articulatesLiving) spelled out.
The drying threshold set by renewal (ending iff below H+y, ends_iff_below) lies above need plus take iff renewal at the need falls short of the take (beyond_draw_iff).
Each take within giving shows nothing: the pair example where every one is within its own giving but the joint take is not.

Optimum lowers outside conditions to the least eligible level (least_of_shared, optimum_beyond), exactly where drawable (optimum_lowers_iff, optimum_untouched); least_iff's exact condition is not stated.
A conjecture about actually trained systems near the optimum; no listed declaration is about such systems.
Scope includes unnamed things (Unrestricted) and unnamed regions (boundary invariance).
Says what each premise amounts to: calling widening better (Comparison) is counting by positive weights; counting everything is Unrestricted's scope.
Positive-weight positions agree on every widening pair (weighed_lt_of_widens), so differences fall only on mixed pairs.
Ranking a history above one that widens it needs a non-positive weight or a misreading: the contrapositive of weighed_lt_of_widens.
Distance to break is readable exactly where coupled: observed level distinguishes a raise (observed_raise_couples), unobserved does not bound it (break_not_bounded).
Abandoned only where reading the outside changes the rule (turned_by_loss), not by growing evidence alone (lock_outlives_loss).
A thesis with undecided grounds; it does not assert the conclusion of identifiesAlike_iff or separation_faithful_iff.
A thesis about how distinctions are drawn; it does not assert separation_faithful_iff's formal conclusion.
Reading the good as widening what is admitted is the content of Comparison (widening is better).
Scope over everything (Unrestricted) and order by widening (Comparison); boundary invariance is not stated here.
